description: This policy setting allows you to decide how the clipboard behaves while in Microsoft Defender Application Guard.

options.description: Completely turns Off the clipboard functionality for the Application Guard.

options.displayName: Enable clipboard operation from Application Guard to the host
options.description: Turns On clipboard operation from an isolated session to the host.

options.displayName: Enable clipboard operation from the host to Application Guard
options.description: Turns On clipboard operation from the host to an isolated session.

options.displayName: Enable clipboard operation in both directions
options.description: Turns On clipboard operation in both the directions.
